subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB450 - THE OTHER HALF OF THE SURFACE NOW PARSES, so PARTIAL becomes CONFORMS. This row recorded the semantic claim as implemented for the shape the parser accepted and the compound form as `COBOL0001: unexpected TO` at every edition. The printed figure was re-RENDERED here (PDF p760 / folio 730, 200dpi) rather than taken from the transcription: Format 4 is `SET { { condition-name-1 } ... TO { TRUE | FALSE } } ...` with BOTH ellipses, and its figure note says so in words - "The outer braces enclose the single repeated unit; the trailing `...` repeats the whole braced portion" (cite.py --check 14.9.39.2 OK). The grammar now writes the printed shape, `setBooleanStatement : SET setConditionPhrase+`, and the repeated unit is a NAMED RULE rather than an inline group - which is the structural half: an inline `( ... )+` flattens the phrases into one dataReference list and one TO list, so BOTH binders that read Format 3's twin (SetAlterBinder.SwitchBindSet and the legacy DataStatementBinder.BindSetSwitch) carried a hand-written re-assembly of the grouping by token index. Both now loop over phrase nodes, and `PrintedFormatAlternativeDriftTests.EverySetStatementRule_NamesItsRepeatedUnitInsteadOfInliningIt` fails any future set...Statement that inlines its repeated unit. TRUE/FALSE is now read PER GROUP: BoundSetConditions carries (Place, Condition88, ToTrue) triples, which is GR8 taken literally - "If multiple condition-names are specified, the results are the same as if a separate SET statement had been written for each condition-name-1". MEASURED on this worktree's own build: `SET F-YES TO TRUE G-HIGH TO TRUE` gives F=Y G=9 at --std 85 (was a parse error at every edition), `SET P-YES TO TRUE Q-YES TO FALSE` gives P=Y Q=N at 2002, and three groups act in written order (P2=Y). The COBOL-2002 gate on the FALSE arm is asked per PHRASE now, so a FALSE written in the SECOND group still draws COBOL0900 at 85 (negative/pb450-set-false-in-second-group-below-2002) - a statement-level question would have found no FALSE token and let it through. ⚠ The row's sibling FMT-14.9.39.2 is NOT closed by this: Format 7's receiving-operand repetition and its mixed `{ADDRESS OF data-name-1 | identifier-5}` brace are still arity-one, which is PB450's second mechanism and stays open.
